title: Discovery: Registry Query Performance Optimization
problem: Registry queries against HKLM execute slowly (8-10s cold), blocking tool availability. Need query optimization or caching.
cause: First HKLM registry access loads entire hive into memory. Subsequent queries hit cache. No optimization in current framework.

recommended_actions.action: Implement registry query result caching with 5min TTL

lesson_learned: Caching solves cold-start problem but introduces cache invalidation complexity. TTL-based approach only partially addresses performance due to edge cases with registry hive changes.
